map.JIT 编译、CPU 频率动态调整、垃圾回收与其他进程争抢都会引入波动。可靠做法: JIT compilation, dynamic CPU frequency scaling, garbage collection and contention with other processes all introduce variance. The reliable approach: warm up for several rounds so the JIT stabilizes, then take enough repeated samples and report the median and percentiles (p95/p99), comparing on the same machine under similar load. A single run's number means nothing.
